executivo.nota: Leis: as 164 leis ordinárias e complementares com data a partir de 1º/1/2025 cadastradas no SAPL da Câmara, venham de quem vierem (a prefeitura sanciona quase todas). O SAPL não separa as poucas leis que a própria Câmara promulga (quando derruba um veto ou quando o prefeito não assina no prazo), então elas também entram. Faltam no SAPL cerca de 1 dos 161 números de lei do período, contando as que deveriam vir depois da última cadastrada, de 8/10/2026. Vetos: os projetos que, pelo andamento registrado no SAPL, receberam veto total ou parcial a partir de 1º/1/2025.
executivo.nota_en: Laws: the 164 ordinary and complementary laws dated from January 1, 2025 on in the City Council's SAPL system, whoever proposed them (the mayor's office signs almost all of them). SAPL does not separate the few laws the Council promulgates itself (when it overrides a veto or when the mayor does not sign in time), so they are included too. About 1 of the 161 law numbers in the period are missing from SAPL, counting those that should have come after the last one recorded, from October 8, 2026. Vetoes: the bills that, according to the progress recorded in SAPL, were vetoed in whole or in part from January 1, 2025 on.

votacoes.escopo_en: Roll-call votes (where each councilor's vote is recorded) on bills, amendments and vetoes in the full City Council since January 1, 2025, according to the City Council's official system (SAPL). Votes on requests, recommendations, motions and other documents, and votes that did not decide on the proposal (postponing it, asking for more time to review it), are not included.

propostas.escopo_en: Bills (ordinary and complementary laws, amendments to the city's Organic Law, legislative decrees and resolutions) filed since January 1, 2025 (start of the current term), according to the City Council's official system (SAPL).
